title: review baseline readiness
goal: The baseline runs once and cannot be repeated (user, 2026-10-21). Before it, prove the cases and graders are correct and reusable for the whole plan, and make every baseline run re-gradable offline, so a later grader fix never needs a re-run.

phases.title: Smoke: review-ts-boundary + review-py-clean-plugin x1, plugin and bare; graders behave on real output, brief contains team rules and conventions, real cost per run measured.

Offline grader validation ($0 runs): for every case, synthetic outputs (perfect, empty, off-by-a-few-lines, wrong file, plausible false claim, control with a medium finding) pass/fail every deterministic grader as intended; llm graders checked on a few crafted samples; broken graders fixed with tests.

Blind truth audit: an independent reviewer sees only each materialized repo and diff, lists issues, then compares with review-truth.json; unintended issues fixed or added to truth, undetectable or ambiguous planted issues fixed.

Re-grade path: every baseline run keeps its trace, final message and .ambicode/reviews output in the archive, and a script re-applies the current graders to archived runs offline; tested on the smoke runs.
Freeze and run: case set frozen at a recorded commit; full baseline 14x3 plugin + bare (cost confirmed with the user); results and per-category recall/FP in STATE.md.

Completed phase: Smoke: review-ts-boundary + review-py-clean-plugin x1, plugin and bare; graders behave on real output, brief contains team rules and conventions, real cost per run measured.. Smoke (4 runs, $0.37): ~$0.10/run in both arms; brief carries team rule + conventions; reviewer shallow (4 tool uses, main issue only). Found grader defects: location regex needs the full path and a single line (bare cites basenames/ranges or no location), no-false-claim fails a correct one-finding report 3/3, no-defect-claimed noisy; py control has a bare ValueError against the TW-code convention; plugin readback dropped citations.

Smoke stamps plugin 2026-10-21T13-16-12-785Z / 13-16-42-286Z, bare 13-17-17-191Z / 13-17-51-001Z. ts-boundary: plugin .733 (main only), bare .60 (main + 6 extras, s2 named without location). py control: both 1.0. Harness deletes /tmp sandboxes; results/<arm>.json keeps only the last run -> re-grade path must archive report.txt/answer.json.
